caption: where do her diamonds go 💎
logline: An allay carries every diamond its miner's TNT blasts loose to the singing box in the mine wall, while she climbs out empty-handed every night and says tomorrow she quits; today it follows the biggest one yet through the hole to see where they go, and finds the grumpy man next door playing the box in her diamonds.
question: why has she never had more than one diamond?
premise: A miner under Torch Hill gives her allay her only diamond so it finds more. Every day her TNT blasts diamonds loose, and the allay flies every one to the singing box: a note block in a little hole in the mine wall, by the lava she never goes near. Whenever the box sings the allay flies its finds right to it, and they vanish ('it must be so hungry'). She climbs out with empty hands every night: 'Nothing again. Tomorrow, I quit.' The grumpy man next door shouts that some of us are trying to sleep; the allay never sees him in the day.
twist: The note block isn't hers. The neighbor dug a secret room beside her tunnel and plays his note block behind the hole every few seconds. Vanilla: an allay that hears a note block played within 16 blocks delivers its items there instead of to its player, for 30 s, and each note resets it. So her allay has delivered all 31 diamonds to him, and he wears them (diamond chestplate, leggings, boots, pickaxe and sword: 24 of them; his helmet off so his face reads). Diamond 32 lands at his feet as he taps. Cut on the tap.
payoff_note: `tap`: the stunt mark when the neighbor's hand taps the note block in S13b, on 'PLAYING' in L15; diamond 32 lands at his feet on 'FOUND'; he says L16 'Thirty-TWO.' looking down at it; the Short ends 0.8 s after L16 (STANDARDS 0y: the reveal SAID, one beat, cut).

lines.text: My best FRIEND / has never kept / a single DIAMOND. / I've found her / THIRTY-ONE. / And I don't know WHY.
lines.say: My best friend has never kept a single diamond. I've found her thirty-one. And I don't know WHY.
lines.direction: amazed, then truly puzzled on the last sentence, one quick bright breath

lines.text: I'm her ALLAY. / She gave me / her ONE diamond, / to find MORE.
lines.say: I'm her allay. She gave me her one diamond, to find MORE.

lines.text: She lights / the BOOM blocks, / and RUNS.
lines.say: She lights the boom blocks, and RUNS.

lines.direction: delighted, the best part of the day

lines.text: I catch them ALL, / for the singing BOX / in the wall.
lines.say: I catch them all, for the singing box in the WALL.

lines.text: It's by the glowy / orange WATER. / She never goes / NEAR it.
lines.say: It's by the glowy orange water. She never goes NEAR it.
lines.direction: cheerful tour guide, repeating her rule like a good student

lines.text: When it SINGS, / I fly them / RIGHT to it. / It LOVES me!
lines.say: When it sings, I fly them right to it. It LOVES me!

lines.text: I drop them ON it. / GONE! / It must be / so HUNGRY.
lines.say: I drop them on it. Gone! It must be so HUNGRY.

lines.text: Some of us / are trying / to SLEEP!
lines.say: Some of us are trying to SLEEP!

lines.text: That's the grumpy man / next DOOR. / He sleeps all DAY, / and the boom blocks / WAKE him!
lines.say: That's the grumpy man next door. He sleeps all day, and the boom blocks WAKE him!
lines.direction: matter-of-fact, a little sorry for him; it believes him

lines.text: I won't let her QUIT! / Today, / she lit THREE.
lines.say: I won't let her quit! Today, she lit THREE.

lines.text: The box SANG, / so I flew it / through the HOLE, / to see / where they GO.
lines.say: The box sang, so I flew it through the hole, to see where they GO.
lines.direction: curious and brave, running straight into the next line

lines.text: And there was / the grumpy man, / PLAYING the box, / wearing every diamond / I ever FOUND.
lines.say: And there was the grumpy man, playing the box, wearing every diamond I ever FOUND.
lines.direction: surprised and plain, just saying what it sees; no gasp, no sadness, the last word bright
